# Play — Newton's Cradle

- SudokuPad: [Newton's Cradle on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Newton's Cradle on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Pendulums are an invented rule, so no app enforces them. Each one is exported as a **cosmetic** slate line (0.12 wide) with a white circle
on its first cell. I have not opened the links in a browser myself. `grid.svg` in this folder is the reference picture.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, givens, solution).
